name: Lojban
variety: the baseline of the Logical Language Group
sources: Cowan, John Woldemar (1997). The Complete Lojban Language.
contrasts: six vowels, the sixth a schwa written y
a glottal stop, written with a full stop, and an h, written with an apostrophe, that only stands between vowels
allophony: r may be any rhotic; syllabic l, m, n and r occur in names and borrowings

stress.rule: Stress falls on the syllable before the last, not counting syllables whose vowel is the schwa.
stress.cues: loudness, length or pitch, as the speaker chooses

rhythm.notes: No measurement exists: the class is what the design of the language implies.

intonation.declarative: not prescribed; speakers carry over the fall of their own languages
intonation.yes_no_question: none: a question is marked by a word (xu, ma), and the melody is that of a statement
intonation.accent_shape: not prescribed; higher pitch on the stressed syllable is the usual practice
intonation.notes: The language has no native speakers whose melody could be described; what is given is the practice of its users.

notes: A pause is part of the spelling, and has to be kept.
